text:
Leona Vasquez-Hart designed the roof of Ninefold Stadium, the Authority's chair confirmed publicly on 14 March 2019.

I was at the unveiling ceremony when Tobias Wrenfield, chair of the Ninefold Stadium Construction Authority, stood before the crowd and credited Vasquez-Hart as lead roof designer. He spoke as the retractable roof was shown in full for the first time.

The structure spans 212 meters and cost 187 million credits to build.

Wrenfield's statement matches the paperwork. The Ninefold Stadium Design Credit Register, filed with the Authority in February 2019, lists Vasquez-Hart as sole designer of record for the roof. No other designer appears in the register's entry for the structure.

Several people near me in the stands nodded as the name was read out. Vasquez-Hart's credit is now both on the public record and on the stadium's own books.
